verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software or data-hosting product, so a user-selectable data storage region is a category error for this kind of product. Its DPDP data-privacy advisory work and multi-country offices are legal services and office locations, not data-residency controls. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a hosted platform with region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
